intro: In the corner of the tournament hall, beside the rack where the spare clocks are kept, there is a rack of wooden slots, each shaped and sized by the club's carpenter decades ago, one for every kind of scoresheet the players tend to produce: long and thin for the endgame draws, square for the miniatures, narrow as a pencil for the games that ended in a resignation on move nine. Each sheet, when it comes down from the boards, goes into the slot that takes it without a crease. The last sheet to join them belonged to a grandmaster who resigned in a winning position and never played again, and no other sheet has ever slid into its place. The carpenter's rule, still carved into the rail above, is that a thing belongs where it fits, and nowhere else.
echo: Every good opening starts by giving something away.

puzzles.title: Adjournment
puzzles.flavor: The typesetter dropped the tray. Every letter landed in the right column, at least.
hints: A drop quote: each column's letters (shown alphabetised above it) drop into that column of the grid below. Black squares are spaces; words can wrap between rows. The sentence tells you the answer.
To check you're on track: the answer begins with B.

puzzles.title: Opposition
puzzles.flavor: Static, then something that isn't static.
hints: Morse code, played as beeps. Short = dot, long = dash; longer silences separate letters.
To check you're on track: the answer begins with P.

puzzles.title: Zwischenzug
puzzles.flavor: Not a single letter on the page, and yet it says something.
hints: Each symbol stands for one letter (a simple substitution); word breaks are kept. Solve the sentence; it tells you the answer.
To check you're on track: the answer begins with D.

puzzles.title: Windmill
puzzles.flavor: The labels in the tournament hall have faded. Each one lost exactly one letter.
hints: Each theme word is missing one letter. The missing letters, in order, spell the answer.
To check you're on track: the answer begins with T.

puzzles.title: Desperado
puzzles.flavor: The typesetter shook each word like a box of tiles, one word at a time.
hints: Each word of a sentence has had its letters shuffled. Unscramble them; the sentence tells you the answer.
To check you're on track: the answer begins with N.

puzzles.title: Smothered Mate
puzzles.flavor: Every letter in the tournament hall took the same number of steps down the road, and none of them came back.

blocks.text: LAHNEW MABL GHMX YTEE BGMH MAX PKHGZ ATGWL IEXTLX YHKZXM MAX PHKW DGBZAM

hints: Every letter of the sentence was shifted along the alphabet by the same amount. Find the shift; the sentence tells you the answer.
To check you're on track: the answer begins with K.

meta.title: Meta: The Endgame Study
meta.flavor: Pigeonholes, each cut to fit one thing, and some of them marked.
hints: Each answer fits exactly one row of the grid by length; the shaded squares, top to bottom, spell the final answer.
To check you're on track: the final answer begins with G.
